site.name: Demonstration Plant
site.note: Demonstration layout. One physical proof-of-concept node; all other assets are simulated or replayed.

assets.name: Drive Motor M1
assets.description: Small DC geared motor monitored by the ESP32 proof-of-concept node. Shown as a conceptual direct-drive motor; the real unit's integral gearbox is not modelled.

assets.name: Transfer Conveyor C1
assets.description: Virtual conveyor driven by MOTOR-001. Belt speed is the drum surface speed computed from the measured RPM. It has no sensors of its own.

drive.note: Conceptual. The measured RPM is applied to the drive drum. If the Hall sensor sits on the motor shaft rather than the output, set reduction to the gear ratio.

assets.name: Recorded Motor (Replay)
assets.description: Plays back a recorded session, sample by sample.

component_library._note: General engineering reference for conceptual models. Not manufacturer data. Material, dimensions, manufacturer and part number are unknown unless entered for a specific asset.

housing.name: Housing
housing.description: Outer frame that supports the stator and dissipates heat.
housing.inspection: Check for dirt on cooling surfaces and that mounting bolts are tight.

stator.name: Stator
stator.description: Stationary windings that create the magnetic field.
stator.inspection: Insulation resistance test by qualified personnel with the machine isolated.

rotor.name: Rotor
rotor.description: Rotating core that turns the shaft.
rotor.inspection: Check for rub marks and balance condition.

shaft.name: Shaft
shaft.description: Transmits torque to the driven load.
shaft.inspection: Check coupling alignment and that the load turns freely by hand with power isolated.

bearing_de.name: Drive-end bearing
bearing_de.description: Supports the shaft at the load side.
bearing_de.inspection: Listen and feel for roughness, check play and lubrication. Replace only following the approved procedure.

bearing_nde.name: Non-drive-end bearing
bearing_nde.description: Supports the shaft at the fan side.

cooling_fan.name: Cooling fan
cooling_fan.description: Shaft-mounted fan that moves air over the housing.
cooling_fan.inspection: Check blades and that the cowl intake is clear.

fan_cowl.name: Fan cowl
fan_cowl.description: Guard that directs cooling air along the housing.

end_shield.name: End shield
end_shield.description: End cover that carries a bearing.

terminal_box.name: Terminal box
terminal_box.inspection: With power isolated, check terminal tightness and for signs of heating.

base.name: Mounting feet / base
base.description: Fixes the machine to its foundation.
base.inspection: Check bolt tightness and that all feet sit flat.

impeller.name: Impeller
impeller.description: Rotating bladed element that moves the fluid.
impeller.inspection: Clean and inspect blades; check balance.

motor.name: Drive motor
motor.inspection: Check cooling path and current draw.

volute.name: Volute casing
volute.description: Pump casing that converts velocity into pressure.
volute.inspection: Inspect for wear and blockage during overhaul.

seal.name: Mechanical seal
seal.description: Seals the shaft where it enters the casing.
seal.inspection: Check for leakage at the seal.

coupling.name: Coupling
coupling.description: Joins the shaft to the driven machine and turns with it.
coupling.inspection: Check alignment, bolt tightness and the flexible element with power isolated.

tank.name: Air receiver
tank.inspection: Drain condensate. Pressure vessels require statutory inspection.

cylinder_head.name: Cylinder and head
cylinder_head.description: Compression cylinder with cooling fins and valves.

belt.name: Belt
belt.description: Endless conveyor belt running around the drive and tail drums.

rollers.name: Carrying idlers
rollers.description: Rollers that support the loaded belt. Each turns at the belt speed divided by its radius.
rollers.inspection: Check that every roller turns freely.

frame.name: Frame
frame.description: Fixed side beams and cross ties of the conveyor.

hub.name: Fan hub
hub.description: Carries the blades and fixes them to the shaft.
hub.inspection: Check the hub is tight on the shaft and free of cracks.

blades.name: Fan blades
blades.description: Pitched blades that move air along the fan axis. They turn together with the hub.
blades.inspection: Clean the blades and check each for damage and equal pitch.

grille.name: Protective grille
grille.description: Fixed guard in front of the rotating blades.
grille.inspection: Clear debris and check the fixings.

back_plate.name: Back plate
back_plate.description: Closes the pump casing behind the impeller and carries the seal.

piston.name: Piston
piston.description: Moves up and down in the cylinder to compress air. Driven by the crank through the connecting rod.
piston.inspection: Check compression and inspect rings during overhaul.

connecting_rod.name: Connecting rod
connecting_rod.description: Links the crank pin to the piston, turning rotation into reciprocation.

crankshaft.name: Crankshaft
crankshaft.description: Turns with the flywheel; its offset pin drives the connecting rod.
crankshaft.inspection: Check end float and journal condition.

cylinder.name: Cylinder
cylinder.description: Finned barrel in which the piston runs.
cylinder.inspection: Clean the fins; inspect the bore during overhaul.

vbelt.name: V-belt
vbelt.description: Transmits power from the motor pulley to the flywheel.

motor_pulley.name: Motor pulley
motor_pulley.description: Small pulley on the motor shaft. It turns faster than the flywheel by the ratio of their diameters.
motor_pulley.inspection: Check the groove and that the pulley is tight.

bearing_input.name: Input-shaft bearing
bearing_input.description: Supports the high-speed input shaft of the gearbox.
bearing_input.inspection: Check for play and noise; check oil level.

drive_drum.name: Drive drum
drive_drum.description: Powered drum at the head of the conveyor. Its surface speed is the belt speed.

tail_drum.name: Tail drum
tail_drum.description: Idle drum at the tail of the conveyor that returns the belt.
tail_drum.inspection: Check it turns freely and is clean.

return_idlers.name: Return idlers
return_idlers.description: Rollers that support the empty belt on its way back.

legs.name: Support legs
legs.description: Fixed legs that carry the conveyor frame.

side_guides.name: Side guides
side_guides.description: Fixed rails that keep items on the belt.
